name: pitch_env
summary: Per-note pitch envelope (control rate): on/off + 4 rates (0..99) + 3 levels (Q15 pitch offset, bipolar). Retriggers to attack on every note-on (`trigger` = voice_trig[v]); a gate edge starts release. The one-pole uses `fm1_rate_coeff[rate]`; the level targets are the signed Q15 levels l1..l3; `cv` is the pitch offset (0 when off).
